newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Chemical plant to join Bucharest bourse trading.
newsitem.headline: Chemical plant to join Bucharest bourse trading.

text.p: Private chemical company Sinteza SA will join second-tier trading on the Bucharest bourse from next Monday, bringing to 36 the number of traded listings on both tiers, the exchange said late on Friday.
Sinteza has share capital of 43.92 billion lei with a nominal value of 1,000 lei each.
Employees of Sinteza hold over 51.6 percent of the capital, with the rest held privately. Sinteza reported a 3.63 billion lei net profit for 1995, but no financial data for 1996.
The Bucharest bourse has four first-tier listings and 31 in the second tier.
The first-tier has dominated trading over the past months, amounting over 80 percent of turnover.
